info.title: CreatOK API
info.description: Asynchronous media generation and TikTok Shop publishing API. Authenticate with a Bearer organization API key (cok_). Personal CLI/MCP keys are not accepted. Resource responses are returned directly, without a code/data envelope. Each response includes X-Request-Id.

post.summary: Prepare an uploaded file for this connection
post.description:
Upload your file with POST /files and complete the signed multipart upload first. Send its file_id with kind=video or kind=cover. This endpoint prepares that file for the selected connection and returns a pm_ ID with status=prepared. Use the returned ID as media.prepared_video_id or media.prepared_cover_id in POST /publishing/tasks. Prepared media cannot be reused across workspaces or connections. URLs and storage paths are not accepted. Preparation does not publish content.

TikTok Shop only. The key creator must remain a workspace member with current account access. Read requests: 120/minute/workspace; writes: 30/minute/workspace (configurable). Media preparation and new submissions require Plus or higher. Video submission uses your API wallet; photos, reads, media preparation and cancellation are free. See https://www.creatok.ai/app/api-platform/pricing for current prices. Accepted tasks continue after plan downgrade. Unknown results are not automatically resent or refunded.

post.summary: Submit one Shop video or photo set
post.description:
Submit a TikTok Shop video or photo set. For video, provide media.prepared_video_id and optionally prepared_cover_id; provider_options requires product_id and product_title. For photos, provide media.file_ids and provider_options.post_type with the matching product_links or shop_link. Use snake_case throughout. timezone is required; omit schedule for immediate publishing or set schedule.at to Unix milliseconds, at least 60 seconds and no more than 30 days ahead. Save kind and task_id from the 202 response and poll GET /publishing/tasks/{kind}/{task_id}; acceptance is not publication. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key and body after a timeout. A changed body with the same key returns 409. See [Publishing request options](/guides/publishing#submit-a-video) for video and photo option fields.

TikTok Shop only. The key creator must remain a workspace member with current account access. Read requests: 120/minute/workspace; writes: 30/minute/workspace (configurable). Media preparation and new submissions require Plus or higher. Video submission uses your API wallet; photos, reads, media preparation and cancellation are free. See https://www.creatok.ai/app/api-platform/pricing for current prices. Accepted tasks continue after plan downgrade. Unknown results are not automatically resent or refunded.

get.summary: List authorized account tasks in this workspace, across all sources
get.description:
List tasks for accounts you can access in this workspace. kind is required. Results include all creation sources; set client_source=openapi to restrict them to API submissions, or unknown for tasks without a recorded source. Filter by connection_uid, status, and inclusive created_after_ms/created_before_ms Unix millisecond bounds. Results are ordered newest first. page starts at 1; page_size defaults to 20 and accepts 1–100. Returns data, page, page_size, total, and has_more.

post.summary: Cancel an eligible unsent task; refund its original charge
post.description:
Cancel an eligible task before publication starts. Use its kind and task_id; no request body is needed. Returns the current task, including an already canceled task. If publication has started or the task is otherwise ineligible, returns 409 task_not_cancellable. Cancellation cannot delete a published post. Read cost.refunded_usd for the booked refund of any original API charge.

TikTok Shop only. The key creator must remain a workspace member with current account access. Read requests: 120/minute/workspace; writes: 30/minute/workspace (configurable). post.summary: Create a size-limited file upload grant
post.description: Upload with multipart/form-data POST, include every returned upload_fields entry, and put the file field last. The storage service enforces the signed size limit: 10 MiB for image content types, 100 MiB otherwise. The grant expires after six hours. Finish uploading before referencing file_id or upload_fields.key in generation input. Upload success does not guarantee model compatibility; generation validates media type, dimensions, duration and model-specific limits.

200.description: A signed multipart POST upload form and its object identifier.

post.summary: Remove burned-in subtitles from a selected area
post.description: Submit an asynchronous video cleaning job. Upload with POST /files first. Supported videos: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM and MKV, 1–60 seconds, at most 50 MiB. Subtitle removal requires selected_area with normalized coordinates in [0,1]; watermark removal processes the full frame. Media properties are inspected by the server. Pricing is based on server-inspected source duration. See https://www.creatok.ai/app/api-platform/pricing for current rates. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key and body after a timeout. Poll GET /jobs/{jobId}; outputs expire 48 hours after completion. Always inspect Job.status, including on 202 responses.

202.description: Accepted Job, or original Job on idempotent replay.

post.description: Generate from text, reference images/videos/audio, or first/end frames. Seedance 2, Mini, and Fast require at least one reference image or video when you provide audio; audio alone is rejected. Veo models support text, first/end frames, and model-specific reference images. Seedance 2.5 also supports adaptive editing. Seedance charges use estimated token usage; Veo charges use model-specific output-second rates. Reference video duration contributes to Seedance usage. See https://www.creatok.ai/app/api-platform/pricing for current rates. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key and body to retrieve the original Job without another charge; changing the body with that key returns 409. The default workspace limit is 10 unfinished jobs. Always inspect Job.status, including on 202 responses.

Replace the background with a beach

202.description: A Job resource, including idempotent replays and immediate submission failures. Retry-After: 10 is included while queued/running.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before retrying a concurrency-limited request.

503.description: Concurrency checking is temporarily unavailable. Retry with the same idempotency key and body.

Retry-After.description: Present only while queued/running; seconds before polling again.
